name: Spec Kit
description: Self-contained GitHub Spec Kit toolchain: uv, Python 3.11+ when needed, and the Specify CLI (specify-cli). No VS Code Python extensions.

specifyVersion.description: PyPI version of specify-cli. Use latest to install the current PyPI release at image build time, then align to speckit_version from .specify/init-options.json on first container create when that file exists.

uvVersion.description: uv release version to install from GitHub (semver tag without a leading v).

managedPython.description: When to run uv python install: auto skips if python3 on PATH is already 3.11+ with a working stdlib; always installs; never requires that python3.

pythonVersion.description: Python version for uv python install when managed Python runs.
